news.headline: Delcath Systems Amends Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: The board amended and restated Delcath's bylaws so that Delaware's Court of Chancery (or federal district court) is the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims, and U.S. federal courts are exclusive for Securities Act claims. This is a routine Delaware-incorporated-company governance update recommended by the Nominating and Corporate Governance Committee, not related to any pending litigation; the stock also touched a fresh 52-week high of $17.42 around this time.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Management presented to investors at the Canaccord Genuity Growth Conference in Boston shortly after the Q2 earnings beat, reinforcing the HEPZATO commercial-ramp story to a broader institutional audience.

news.headline: Analysts Raise Price Targets After Delcath's Q2 Beat: H.C. Wainwright to $32, Others Reiterate Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright raised its price target on DCTH to $32 (from $30) while maintaining Buy, and Craig-Hallum reiterated Buy at $24; Wall Street Zen also upgraded the stock to Buy. The wave of positive analyst action followed the strong Q2 print and raised guidance, with sell-side consensus remaining Strong Buy in the low-$20s to low-$30s range.

news.headline: Delcath Reports Q2 2026 Results: $29.1M Revenue Beats Estimates, Raises Full-Year Guidance to $104M-$108M
news.summary: Total revenue rose 20% year-over-year to $29.1M (HEPZATO KIT $27.1M, +21%; CHEMOSAT $2.0M), with gross margin expanding to 90% and net income of $2.7M; HEPZATO volume grew ~30% YoY. Delcath raised FY2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M, now operates 31 active treatment centers (targeting 37 by year-end), and highlighted independent investigator data from Hannover Medical School showing a 60% hepatic partial response rate (9 of 15 patients) with percutaneous hepatic perfusion in heavily pretreated liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Announces Inducement Grants Under Nasdaq Listing Rule 5635(c)(4)
news.summary: Delcath granted inducement RSU awards to newly hired employees as a material inducement to employment, a routine Nasdaq-required disclosure that also signals continued headcount growth to support the HEPZATO commercial expansion.

news.headline: Delcath Announces First Patient Dosed in Phase 2 HEPZATO Trial for Liver-Dominant Metastatic Breast Cancer
news.summary: First patient dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the ~90-patient randomized DELUMA trial (NCT06875128, also known as PHP-MBC-202) evaluating HEPZATO plus standard of care in HER2-negative liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer. This marks the key pipeline expansion beyond ocular melanoma into a much larger indication.

catalysts.label: 37 active HEPZATO treatment centers
catalysts.detail: Delcath ended Q2 2026 with 31 active HEPZATO KIT centers and plans to activate roughly six more by year-end to reach 37 sites, a key driver of continued volume growth.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Delcath's next quarterly report is estimated for around November 10, 2026 based on consensus tracking, following the pattern of prior years; the company has not yet formally announced the date. It will be the next test of execution against the raised full-year guidance and center-activation pace.

catalysts.label: DELUMA breast cancer trial enrollment
catalysts.detail: The randomized Phase 2 HEPZATO trial in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer (~90 patients, NCT06875128/PHP-MBC-202) is now enrolling across US/EU sites after dosing its first patient in July 2026, backed by supportive retrospective data (60% hepatic partial response rate) presented by independent investigators at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026; enrollment updates and eventual readouts are the next pipeline catalysts.

catalysts.label: FY2026 revenue guidance of $104M-$108M
catalysts.detail: After the Q2 beat, Delcath raised full-year 2026 revenue guidance to $104M-$108M with gross margin guidance of 86%-89%, implying continued HEPZATO KIT volume growth and a path to positive adjusted EBITDA; subsequent quarters will show whether the company is tracking toward this range.

catalysts.label: mCRC indication expansion / Phase 2 data
catalysts.detail: Ongoing colorectal-cancer Phase 2 work and the published CHOPIN combination data (Lancet Oncology, showing tripled 1-year PFS with HEPZATO plus immunotherapy in uveal melanoma) underpin potential label and indication expansion beyond melanoma and breast cancer.

pulse: Delcath remains in a strong post-Q2 uptrend: the August 6 beat (revenue $29.1M, up 20% YoY, ~30% HEPZATO volume growth, 90% gross margin) and raised FY2026 guidance to $104M-$108M pushed shares to a fresh 52-week high of $17.42 in mid-August, with H.C. Wainwright lifting its target to $32 and sell-side consensus staying Strong Buy. In the roughly five weeks since, no major new catalysts have emerged beyond routine items (Canaccord Genuity conference appearance, inducement grants, a housekeeping Delaware-forum bylaw amendment); the operative story is unchanged execution against 37 active treatment centers by year-end and enrollment in the DELUMA Phase 2 breast-cancer trial, which is supported by encouraging independent retrospective data (60% hepatic partial response rate) presented at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026. Next scheduled catalyst is Q3 2026 earnings, expected around early-to-mid November.
